Resolver in programs/develop/lib/manifest-utils.ts matches the prefix map, including safari:/webkit: beating chromium-family keys. Checked every outbound link with curl and the sponsor assets on disk. images/sponsors/testmuai.svg and testmuai_dark.svg exist; extension-js/docs, BACKERS.md and TELEMETRY.md all return 200. Built a manifest exercising background/action/side_panel/content_scripts: every documented output rewrite was exact (background/service_worker.js, sidebar/index.html, action/index.html, content_scripts/content-0.js|.css). The legacy-path list matches LEGACY_MANIFEST_PATH_RULES one for one. Two claims failed when run: the legacy warning is not dev-only, and public/manifest.json is not ignored.

Verified against the real packages: chrome-devtools-mcp@1.7.0 documents --categoryExtensions with the exact pipe-only / 'not supported ... until 149' caveat the Note reproduces, and @extension.dev/mcp@10.9.0 exposes every extension_* tool named on the page (extension_dev, extension_build, extension_manifest_validate, extension_open, extension_list_extensions, extension_logs, extension_storage, extension_eval, extension_reload, extension_start). Both templates exist (examples/new, examples/content) and both screenshot images resolve. import.meta.env.EXTENSION_PUBLIC_* and process.env.EXTENSION_PUBLIC_* are both defined in programs/develop/plugin-compilation/env.ts, and background.type === 'module' is honored in feature-scripts/steps/add-scripts.ts.
